source: hi can U make a dress up game where there is a VIP area and U must use robux to go in and it cost 221 robux and a free area for all players and can U make rankings and make a runway after 10 minutes to dress up

answers.ask: No look was stated - should this read as glossy pink fashion-show, or a sleeker modern catwalk?
answers.answer: Make it a glossy pink fashion-show style, since it is a dress-up game with a runway.

answers.ask: Is the VIP area a separate room you walk into, or a fenced-off part of the same open space? Going inside adds a slower build step.
answers.answer: Make the VIP area a fenced-off part of the same open space, with entry locked behind the 221 Robux purchase.

scene_prompt: Create a glossy pink fashion-show dress-up map with a shared open styling area for all players and a fenced-off VIP section within the same space. Place a prominent runway/catwalk as the central presentation area, with surrounding open floor space for dressing up.
blob:
### Genre
Dominant genre: Roleplay & Avatar Sim, specifically a dress-up game. The progression, purchase, rankings, and timed runway cycle establish intent but do not add layout mechanics.

### Shape and preset
Use `stage-runway`, matched to the Dress Up preset. The runway is a glossy pink central catwalk for fashion presentation, with preparation and social space arranged around it. The VIP area stays within this same open venue rather than becoming a separate interior or a second map.

### Config requirements
Use visible `social-hub` geometry: broad shared open styling floor around the catwalk where players gather and prepare outfits. No enterable-interior option applies. The VIP restriction is invisible access logic and must not appear in the image; its visible counterpart is only a clearly fenced VIP enclosure with a single formal entry opening. Rankings and the ten-minute cycle are UI/mechanics, not layout components.

### Layout components
Place one medium-sized open fashion-show venue. A long raised runway/catwalk occupies the central axis, ending in a prominent presentation pose area; leave generous glossy floor around both sides as the free styling and gathering zone. Put the fenced VIP section along one side of the catwalk, visually premium through pink-gold trim, plush seating, and a direct view toward the runway, but keep it physically part of the same continuous room. Use low decorative fencing and an entry gate rather than walls or rooms. The free area remains the larger surrounding floor, with enough clear circulation around the runway and between the VIP fence and venue edge. Use a simple outer venue boundary such as pink walls, railings, or a polished stage perimeter. Frame the composition symmetrically, runway leading from foreground toward its presentation end, VIP visible to one side.

### Render order
Use `isometric`: render the isometric venue first as authoritative, then derive the top-down plan. Invalid topology would not make this open social venue unplayable.

### Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Scale band: medium, driven by one shared styling floor, a central catwalk, and a contained VIP enclosure. Theme: glossy pink fashion-show, polished reflective surfaces, pink-gold accents, upscale runway lighting. Pipeline modifier: `P0`; this is one continuous single-surface open space with no interiors, stacked surfaces, separate maps, or topology that must be generated valid by construction.
